name: Vendor registration invitation
subject: You're invited to register as an Alamtri vendor
body:
Hello {vendorName},

You have been invited to register as a vendor for Alamtri Geo. Use the secure link below to create your company profile. This invitation is valid until {expiryDate}.

Invitation code: {code}

Registration is by invitation only — please do not share this link. If you did not expect this invitation, contact {contact}.

name: Vendor registration received
subject: We received your vendor registration
body:
Hello {vendorName},

Thank you — your vendor registration has been submitted to Alamtri Procurement for review. We will email you once your account is approved, after which you can sign in to manage your profile.

Reference: {code}

No further action is needed right now.

name: Vendor registration approved
subject: Your vendor registration is approved
body:
Hello {vendorName},

Good news — your vendor registration has been approved by Alamtri Procurement as of {date}. Your company is now part of the Alamtri vendor registry.

You can sign in to your Vendor Workspace to keep your profile and documents up to date.

Thank you for completing the registration.

name: Vendor registration rejected
subject: Your vendor registration was not approved
body:
Hello {vendorName},

Thank you for your interest in registering as an Alamtri vendor. After review, your registration has not been approved at this time.

Reason: {reason}

If you believe this was in error or would like more information, please contact {contact}.

name: Vendor revision requested
subject: Action needed: please revise your vendor registration
body:
Hello {vendorName},

Alamtri Procurement has reviewed your vendor registration and needs some changes before it can be approved.

What to revise: {reason}

Please sign in to your Vendor Workspace, update the requested items, and submit again for review.

name: Vendor approval request
subject: Vendor registration awaiting your approval
body:
Hello {approverName},

{vendorName} has reached {status} and is waiting for your approval.

Open Vendor Approval to review the complete vendor dossier and status history:
{approvalUrl}

name: Vendor password reset
subject: Reset your Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace password
body:
Dear Sir/Madam, {name},

We have received a request to reset the password for your Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace account. Please open the link below to choose a new password:

{resetUrl}

If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email — your account remains secure. If you need further assistance, please contact our Administrator.

Thank you,
Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace — Notification System

—

Yth. Bapak/Ibu, {name},

Kami menerima permintaan untuk melakukan reset password pada akun Anda di Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace. Silakan buka tautan berikut untuk membuat password baru:

{resetUrl}

Jika Anda tidak merasa melakukan permintaan reset password, mohon abaikan email ini — akun Anda tetap aman. Apabila Anda memerlukan bantuan lebih lanjut, silakan menghubungi Admin kami.

Terima kasih,
Alamtri Geo Vendor Workspace — Sistem Notifikasi
